purpose: Use the official evaluator's exact node matching to partition full-movie OOF edge errors into missing-endpoint and association-limited mechanisms.
timing_guard: Do not run on EXP192 outputs or inspect any EXP192 scientific value until all eight immutable chunks pass the all-chunk no-metric gate and the frozen EXP190, EXP191 and EXP195 confirmation artifacts have been built.
primary_arm: The frozen EXP195 selected whole-graph policy on all 175 EXP192 confirmation movies.

decomposition.fn_endpoint_limited: At least one endpoint of a GT edge has no node match from the official evaluator.
decomposition.fn_association_limited: Both GT endpoints are officially matched but their corresponding predicted edge is absent.
decomposition.fp_wrong_association: Both predicted endpoints are officially matched but not to a GT edge.
decomposition.fp_one_sided_anchor: Exactly one endpoint supplies the official sparse-GT validity anchor.
decomposition.ignored_edges: Predicted non-TP edges ignored by the official sparse-GT rule.

integrity_gates: Per-movie decomposed TP equals official edge_tp.
Per-movie endpoint-limited plus association-limited FN equals official edge_fn.
Per-movie classified valid non-TP edges equals official edge_fp.
Report pooled counts, embryo direction, movie-level distributions and bootstrap uncertainty; do not optimize a threshold in this diagnostic.
decision_rule: If endpoint-limited FN dominates with stable direction-level evidence, prioritize detector/count calibration. If association-limited FN and wrong-association FP dominate, prioritize a physically distinct or learned linker. Consider joint division assignment only after ordinary-edge attribution and only if division support is adequate.
